Toolkit Library

Detailed Description

The Hx User Interface Toolkit Library.

Files

  • file hxclipboard.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit clipboard handling.

  • file hxalert.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit alert API.

  • file hxapplicationbar.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Application Bar API. The application bar is a window placed above the application window that contains the application name and optional widgets.

  • file hxcheckbox.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit checkbox control API.

  • file hxcolordialog.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit color picker dialog API.

  • file hxcolumnheader.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit column header API. The column header widget is used by the File Manager application and by the file dialogs, and allows the application to define buttons at the top of multi-column extended lists.

  • file hxcombobox.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit combo box widget API.

  • file hxcommandbutton.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit command button control API. Command buttons are typically used in modal dialogs (for example, the "OK" and "Cancel" widgets).

  • file hxcontainer.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit container API. Containers are used to group a set of child widgets.

  • file hxcursor.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit cursor handling.

  • file hxdialog.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit dialog API.

  • file hxdropdownbox.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit dropdown box widget API.

  • file hxfield.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit text field management API.

  • file hxfiledialog.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit file dialog API. It includes support for the Open File, Save File, Save As File, and New File dialogs.

  • file hxfilelist.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit filelist API. The filelist widget is used by the File dialogs and File Manager application. It is an extended list that displays the contents of a directory.

  • file hxfont.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit font loading and string measurement API.

  • file hxgadget.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit gadget control API. A gadget is a selectable button that can be displayed with an image and/or text. One common use of a gadget is for icons placed in the application bar or in a toolbar.

  • file hxgraphics.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit drawing API.

  • file hxhtmlview.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx HTML Viewer widget.

  • file hximage.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit graphics image API.

  • file hxkeyboard.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit keyboard constants.

  • file hxlabel.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit label API.

  • file hxlist.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit List API. This API is used by both dropdown box and list box widgets.

  • file hxlistbox.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit listbox widget API. A listbox is a widget containing a list of strings.

  • file hxlistextended.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit extended list API.

  • file hxmenu.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit menu API.

  • file hxpinwheel.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit PinWheel API.

  • file hxprogressbar.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Progress Bar API.

  • file hxradiobutton.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit radio button control API.

  • file hxregion.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit region API.

  • file hxresfile.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit resource file API.

  • file hxscrollbar.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit scrollbar API.

  • file hxseparator.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Separator widget API. The separator is a standard graphic primitive placed within the toolkit heirarchy, and provides a visual mechanism to group widgets.

  • file hxslider.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit slider control API.

  • file hxsoftkeyboard.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit soft keyboard API.

  • file hxspinbutton.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit spin button control API.

  • file hxstoragelist.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit storage list API. A storage list is an extended list implementation, containing list items representing the internal store, as well as SD card and USB drive volumes. This widget is used by the File dialogs as well as the File Manager application.

  • file hxtabs.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Tabs API.

  • file hxui.h
    This file lists the HxUI Toolkit public include files.

  • file hxuiinit.h
    This file contains definitions for the initializing and releasing the Hx UI Toolkit and for controlling application behavior.

  • file hxuitypes.h
    This file contains definitions for the basic Hx UI Toolkit data structures.

  • file hxwidget.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit widget API.

  • file hxwindow.h
    This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit window API.
